subject: Post-call: Novalytics throughput & dedicated allocation — next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novalytics.com>, Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@novalytics.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & request: throughput/latency sizing call

Hi Samira / Michael —

Thanks for taking the time on today's discovery call. Quick recap of what we heard:

- Primary workload: real-time personalization (recommendation + short chatbot) across web and mobile
- Peak concurrent requests: ~1.5K RPS for embedding lookups + 200 concurrent generation sessions
- Target p95 latency for generation: <= 250ms at expected concurrency
- Data constraints: customer data must stay within the VPC; SOC 2 evidence required

Next step: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing session (30–45m) with your infra lead so we can map those numbers to GPU pool sizing and discuss autoscaling/fallback policies. Proposed agenda:

1) Confirm traffic patterns and sequence length distributions
2) Discuss exact SLA/latency targets and fallback behaviors
3) Walk through Redwood Dedicated sizing options and preliminary cost bands
4) Identify data residency and KMS requirements

Available times from our side next week (PST):
- Tue 07/14: 10:00–11:00, 15:00–16:00
- Wed 07/15: 09:00–10:00, 13:00–14:00

If those don't work, share a couple of slots that do and we'll coordinate. I'm attaching a short CSV with the few sizing questions that will speed up the call.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: novalytics-sizing-questions.csv (text/csv)]
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@novalytics.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 12:48:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & request: throughput/latency sizing call

Thanks Ben — great summary.

Couple clarifications before we lock a time:
- Our infra lead (list copied) is Aaron Patel (aaron.patel@novalytics.com) — can we include him on the invite? He will own the metric extracts you requested.
- We usually measure concurrency differently: 1.5K RPS is aggregate; for generation the sustained concurrent sessions are closer to 120–180, but spikes can hit 350 for promotional events.
- Sequence length: average 40 tokens, 99th pct under 180.

We can do Tue 07/14 15:00 PST. Can you send a calendar invite and attach the sizing questionnaire and any pre-reads?

Samira
Sr. Product Ops, Novalytics
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novalytics.com>, Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@novalytics.com>

Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & request: throughput/latency sizing call

Samira — perfect, thanks for the clarification and for looping Aaron in.

I've attached the completed sizing CSV and a short Dedicated overview PDF. I also sketched two preliminary sizing options based on the numbers you shared (attached as the CSV row comments):
- Option A: 2x A100-equivalent with autoscale to 4 nodes for spike capacity (lower baseline cost, higher spike latency risk)
- Option B: 3x A100-equivalent reserved with smaller autoscale headroom (higher baseline cost, more stable p95 latency)

Agenda reminder for the call (Tue 07/14 15:00 PST | 18:00 EST | 23:00 GMT):
- 5m intros
- 15m traffic & sequence length validation (Aaron)
- 15m latency SLOs & fallback behavior
- 10m sizing recommendation & next steps

I'll send the calendar invite shortly and include a dial-in + Zoom link. If you want Jordan (network infra) to run through VPC peering and egress, he's on the invite.

Thanks,
Ben
[Attachments: novalytics-sizing-questions.csv (updated), redwood-dedicated-overview.pdf]
